event.distribution_pattern: Distributed to a distributor in Iowa and further distributed to retail stores in Iowa, Illinois, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, and South Dakota.

products.product_description: Hy-Vee Spinach, Tomato, Mozzarella Twice Baked Potatoes, Net Wt. 5 oz wrapped in clear plastic.
products.product_quantity: 13,457 cases (1 case = 42 twice baked potatoes at 5 oz each)
products.code_info: Lot numbers 16012 through 18281. Best if used by October 22, 2018 or before.
products.reason_for_recall: The firm received a recall notice for fire roasted tomatoes and mushrooms because they may potentially be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes and Salmonella. The firm further manufactured products from those raw materials.
